panels.description: Distinct players whose selected-mode activity overlapped the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT active_1d AS "DAU" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: DAU · 24h · $game_mode

panels.description: Distinct players whose selected-mode activity overlapped the last seven days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT active_7d AS "WAU" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: WAU · 7d · $game_mode

panels.description: Participant-hours in completed matches; exact checkpointed activity time for Skyblock.

targets.rawSql: SELECT player_minutes_7d / 60.0 AS "Player hours" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Player time · 7d · $game_mode

panels.description: Share of selected-mode players active on at least two distinct Europe/Paris calendar days in the last 28 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT repeat_rate_28d AS "Repeat rate" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Repeat players · 28d · $game_mode

panels.description: Average visits per selected-mode player over the last 28 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT visits_per_player_28d AS "Visits/player" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Visits / player · 28d

panels.description: Seven-day active players divided by 28-day active players; a bounded stickiness proxy, not calendar-month MAU.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wau_mau_proxy AS "WAU/28d" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Stickiness · WAU / 28d

panels.description: Weighted D1 rate across mature selected-mode cohorts from the last 28 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(d1_retained)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(d1_eligible), 0) AS "D1" FROM metrics.mode_retention_cohorts WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring} AND time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '28 days'

panels.title: Retention D1 · mature cohorts

panels.description: Weighted D7 rate across mature selected-mode cohorts from the last 56 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(d7_retained)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(d7_eligible), 0) AS "D7" FROM metrics.mode_retention_cohorts WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring} AND time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '56 days'

panels.title: Retention D7 · mature cohorts

panels.description: Median selected-mode visit duration over the last seven days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT duration_p50_minutes_7d AS "P50" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Visit duration · P50 · 7d

panels.description: 90th percentile selected-mode visit duration over the last seven days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT duration_p90_minutes_7d AS "P90" FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring}

panels.title: Visit duration · P90 · 7d

panels.description: Europe/Paris calendar-day active players. Each mode is distinct; do not sum curves to estimate unique server players.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", mode AS "metric", active_players AS "value" FROM metrics.mode_usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DAU by game mode

panels.description: Player-hours per Europe/Paris day for the selected mode.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", player_minutes / 60.0 AS "Player hours" FROM metrics.mode_usage_daily WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Player time per day · $game_mode

panels.description: Visits and distinct active players for the selected mode. A competitive visit is one match participation; a Skyblock visit is one admitted island session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", active_players AS "Active players", visits AS "Visits" FROM metrics.mode_usage_daily WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Visits and active players · $game_mode

panels.description: Exact-day cohort retention in Europe/Paris. Immature D1, D7 and D30 points remain null until their observation window closes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", d1_rate AS "D1", d7_rate AS "D7", d30_rate AS "D30" FROM metrics.mode_retention_cohorts WHERE mode = ${game_mode:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retention cohorts · $game_mode

panels.description: Completed competitive matches. Skyblock is session-based and therefore has no match count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", mode AS "metric", completed_matches AS "value" FROM metrics.mode_usage_daily WHERE completed_matches > 0 AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completed matches by game mode

panels.description: Skyblock marketplace listings created and completed deals. Counts are durable PostgreSQL records, not log events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", listings_created AS "Listings created", deals AS "Deals", listings_cancelled AS "Cancelled", listings_expired AS "Expired" FROM metrics.skyblock_market_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Skyblock market · listings and deals

panels.description: Gross marketplace coin volume and fees. These are in-game coins, not real-money revenue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", gross_coins AS "Gross coins", fees_coins AS "Fees", units_sold AS "Units sold" FROM metrics.skyblock_market_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Skyblock market · volume

panels.description: Durable Skyblock milestones. No player, island, quest or item identifier is exposed to Grafana.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", islands_created AS "Islands created", coop_members_joined AS "Co-op joins", quests_completed AS "Quests completed", quests_claimed AS "Quests claimed" FROM metrics.skyblock_progress_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Skyblock progression and co-op

list.definition: SELECT mode AS __text, mode AS __value FROM (SELECT mode FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary UNION SELECT 'Skyblock'::text) modes ORDER BY CASE WHEN mode = 'Skyblock' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, mode
list.label: Game mode
list.name: game_mode
list.query: SELECT mode AS __text, mode AS __value FROM (SELECT mode FROM metrics.mode_engagement_summary UNION SELECT 'Skyblock'::text) modes ORDER BY CASE WHEN mode = 'Skyblock' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, mode
